title: Annotatio V §.II Autoritative (Eph. 4): One Lord, faith, baptism, God — yet diverse gifts for building the body
pass_a_gloss: although next, and as for what remains, grace is given to each, even of diverse degree, according to the measure of the gift of Christ (v. 7), and some are set as Apostles, others as Prophets (v. 11), and that for the οἰκοδομή of the body of Christ — for the edification of the Body of Christ (v. 12).
pass_b_english: Yet afterward, and for what remains, grace is given to each — even in different measures — according to Christ’s gift (v. 7).
Some are set as apostles, others as prophets (v. 11), and that for the building up of Christ’s body (v. 12).
source_text: licèt deinceps & quod reliquum est, unicuique gratia data, etiam diversi gradûs, sit, secundum mensuram doni Christi v. 7. & alii constituti sint Apostoli, alii Prophetae v. 11. idque ad οἰκοδομὴν τοῦ σώματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ ad aedificationem Corporis Christi v. 12.
